quotes.text: The first wealth is health.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Nature's peace will flow into you as sunshine flows into trees.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: All things are poison, and nothing is without poison; the dose alone makes it so a thing is not a poison.
quotes.author: Paracelsus

quotes.text: Early to bed and early to rise, makes a man healthy wealthy and wise.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes.note: an older English proverb he printed, not a line he coined

quotes.text: Sleep and watchfulness, both of them, when immoderate, constitute disease.
quotes.author: Hippocratic Corpus

quotes.text: Leave this military hurry and adopt the pace of Nature. Her secret is patience.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Everybody needs beauty as well as bread, places to play in and pray in, where nature may heal and give strength to body and soul alike.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: in Wildness is the preservation of the world.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: In food excellent medication, in food bad medication, bad and good relatively.
quotes.author: Hippocratic Corpus
quotes.work: On Nutriment 19, trans. W. H. S. Jones
quotes.research_note: the popular “let food be thy medicine” line is a later misquotation; this is the actual corpus wording

quotes.text: Every realm of nature is marvellous.
quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.work: Parts of Animals I.5, trans. William Ogle

quotes.text: As to diseases, make a habit of two things — to help, or at least to do no harm.
quotes.author: Hippocratic Corpus
quotes.work: Epidemics I.11, trans. W. H. S. Jones

quotes.text: The result of all my experiments was that oranges and lemons were the most effectual remedies for this distemper at sea.
quotes.author: James Lind

quotes.text: Tell me what you eat, and I will tell you what you are.
quotes.author: Jean Anthelme Brillat-Savarin

quotes.text: Neither can do anything but remove obstructions; neither can cure; nature alone cures.
quotes.author: Florence Nightingale
quotes.work: Notes on Nursing: What It Is, and What It Is Not

quotes.text: Maintaining a healthy and sound body is among the ways of God.
quotes.author: Maimonides
quotes.work: Mishneh Torah, De'ot 4:1, trans. Eliyahu Touger

quotes.text: The regimen for maintaining health consists essentially in the regulation of exercise, food, and sleep.
quotes.author: Avicenna
quotes.work: The Canon of Medicine, Book I, trans. O. Cameron Gruner

quotes.text: Climb the mountains and get their good tidings.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: Life is short, and Art long; the crisis fleeting; experience perilous, and decision difficult.
quotes.author: Hippocratic Corpus

quotes.text: To be free-minded and cheerfully disposed at hours of meat and of sleep, and of exercise, is one of the best precepts of long lasting.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.text: In every walk with Nature one receives far more than he seeks.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: The patient must co-operate with the physician in combating the disease.
quotes.author: Hippocratic Corpus
quotes.work: Epidemics I.11, trans. W. H. S. Jones
